tools.name: list_skills

tools.name: osint_graph
tools.description: Resolves one public name on Wikidata and returns a relationship graph from a fixed property list (instance of, country, headquarters, founder, chief executive, ownership, employer, education, membership, and similar), up to two hops. People include only notable public roles. If nothing matches, the graph is empty and reason explains why. Price $0.01 via x402.

tools.name: seo
tools.description: Fetches a URL and returns an on-page SEO score from real checks (title, meta, headings, alt text, keywords, and more). If the page cannot be fetched, returns an error status (403/404/5xx), is a CDN/WAF challenge page, or times out (7 s cap), it answers 422 with score null, the reason, and charged:false; no payment is taken. Price $0.012 via x402.

tools.name: seo_v2
tools.description: On-page SEO + AEO audit with paste-ready fixes: 0-100 score across technical, content, metadata, structured data and AI-answer readiness, ~25 checks with severity, and generated title/meta, canonical, Open Graph/Twitter and a JSON-LD skeleton. Scores reflect technical checks only; no ranking or citation is guaranteed. Not charged if the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false). Price $0.0497 via x402.
